requirement.title: Touch Target Size Compliance
requirement.description: All interactive elements must meet WCAG 2.1 AA touch target requirements with minimum 44x44px dimensions

acceptanceCriteria.criteria: All buttons, links, and form controls have minimum 44x44px touch targets
Small icons (under 44x44px) are wrapped in larger touch areas
Touch targets maintain minimum size across all device orientations
Custom interactive components comply with touch target requirements

requirement.title: Adjacent Target Spacing
requirement.description: Maintain adequate spacing between adjacent touch targets to prevent accidental activation

acceptanceCriteria.criteria: Adjacent touch targets have minimum 8px spacing between edges
Navigation items are properly spaced to prevent mis-taps
Form controls have adequate spacing to prevent accidental submissions
Media player controls are properly spaced for touch accuracy

requirement.title: Mobile Gesture Support
requirement.description: Implement standard mobile gestures with proper touch target handling

acceptanceCriteria.criteria: Swipe gestures work with proper touch target areas
Pinch-to-zoom gestures are supported where appropriate
Long press gestures provide appropriate feedback
Touch gestures don't interfere with accessibility features

requirement.title: Touch Feedback and Visual Indicators
requirement.description: Provide clear visual and haptic feedback for touch interactions

acceptanceCriteria.criteria: Touch interactions show immediate visual feedback
Active states are clearly distinguishable from default states
Haptic feedback is provided where appropriate (device-dependent)
Loading states are clearly indicated during touch-initiated actions

requirement.title: Cross-Device Compatibility
requirement.description: Ensure touch targets work consistently across different mobile devices and screen sizes

acceptanceCriteria.criteria: Touch targets work on iOS devices (iPhone/iPad)
Touch targets work on Android devices with various screen densities
Touch interactions work on touch-enabled desktop devices
Responsive design maintains touch target compliance at all breakpoints

requirement.title: Performance Optimization
requirement.description: Optimize touch interactions for smooth performance and minimal latency

acceptanceCriteria.criteria: Touch events respond within 100ms on mobile devices
No jank or stuttering during touch interactions
Touch event handlers are properly optimized and debounced
Memory usage remains stable during extended touch interactions

requirement.title: WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance
requirement.description: All touch target implementations must comply with WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines

requirement.title: Browser Compatibility
requirement.description: Touch targets must work across all supported mobile browsers

requirement.title: Accessibility Integration
requirement.description: Touch targets must integrate properly with screen readers and other assistive technologies

requirement.title: RTL Language Support
requirement.description: Touch target spacing and behavior must work correctly in RTL layouts
